g.text: okl — the Org Knowledge Layer
A lesson is paid for once, in one repo. Every other repo is briefed on it before it can repeat it — enforced at task time, not review time.
1 · A LESSON IS PAID FOR
in whichever repo hits it first
THE THING THAT WENT WRONG
an endpoint fetched a record by id with no owner
predicate — any caller could read any row
THE WRITE — okl record
okl record --type Defect --scope org \
--tags security \
--title "ownership predicate missing" \
--symptom "fetch by id, no owner in WHERE" \
--fix "add caller id to WHERE; 404 on no match"
SYMPTOM · CAUSE · FIX, NOT PROSE
the symptom is what a reader matches against;
the fix is what they do. Cause goes in the body.
A paragraph cannot be routed into an action.
THE WRITE SIDE NEEDS A CATCH
sessions end with the code fixed and the lesson
unrecorded. A Stop hook asks "what did we learn?"
so recording is mechanical, not remembered.
WHAT DOES NOT GO IN
generic advice ("write tests") crowds out the
records that are specific enough to act on, and
anything you cannot cite is a guess that will be
injected into every future task and believed.
2 · ONE TYPED STORE
shared by every connected repo
NODE TYPES (closed vocabulary)
Defect · Rule · Gate · Decision · Tombstone
Retraction · Claim · PriorArt · Vocabulary · Entity
EDGES — how records answer each other
CATCHES · REFUTES · RETRACTS · SUPERSEDES
VERIFIED_ON · RECURS_IN · ENCODES · DEFINED_IN
SCOPE — permission, decided by a human
org → propagates to every connected repo
repo:<name> → never appears in another repo's check
TAGS — subject, from a closed vocabulary
a repo declares its interests; off-interest org
records are filtered out before ranking. Scope is
who may see it; tags are what it is about.
STORAGE — one env var, no code change
OKL_DATABASE_URL: sqlite:///okl.db → postgresql://…
FTS5 BM25 (SQLite) / ts_rank (Postgres), no embeddings
OKL_TOKEN gates every route except /health
3 · EVERY OTHER REPO IS BRIEFED
before the work starts, not at review
A DIFFERENT REPO, WEEKS LATER
task: "add an endpoint returning an invoice"
THE READ — okl check
scope filter → interest filter (tags) → BM25 rank
→ top-k cutoff, with the trimmed count disclosed
WHAT LANDS IN THE CONTEXT
FIX: ownership predicate missing
when you see: fetch by id, no owner in WHERE
→ add caller id to WHERE; 404 on no match
FAIL-CLOSED
unreachable, unconfigured or 401 all exit non-zero.
"No lessons apply" and "nobody was asked" look
identical to an agent, and only one is safe.
HOW IT REACHES THE AGENT
UserPromptSubmit hook: briefing into context
MCP: okl_check · okl_record · okl_search
CLI for humans · CI: okl drift --gate
record
check
VERIFICATION — a stamp is evidence, never a claim
the grader is usually `ls`, not an LLM · verify at decision boundaries · a step saying "done" and the work being done are different facts
1 · ASSERTION (quarantined)
a verified flag with no evidence behind it.
Allowed only when importing historical
receipts; live verification refuses it.
2 · OBSERVED CHECK + EVIDENCE
okl verify <id> --run "pytest -q" \
--expect "passed"
runs it, reads the real outcome, requires the
positive signal, stores command + result.
3 · INDEPENDENT RE-CHECK (CI)
okl drift --gate on every PR — a mechanical
grader with no stake in the claim. Exit 0 is
not a result; the signal has to appear.
4 · TIME ATTACKS EVERY STAMP
drift re-grades when governed files change
after verified_at · TTL decays un-re-earned
stamps to STALE · recurrence-after-arming.
WHY A SIXTH SURFACE
A repo's own method surfaces — its canon, PR rules, architecture review, procedures,
deep context — stay per-repo and unchanged. They cannot help a repo that has never seen
the lesson. The sixth surface holds only the cross-repo subset: org-scoped facts about the
world, enforced fail-closed at task time the way mechanical gates enforce at merge time.
Repo quirks stay repo-scoped and never leak into anyone else's briefing.
MEASURED — held-fixed A/B, blind judge≠generator
baseline 33–42% → briefed 4–8% defect reproduction
two runs, n=24 each · conditional: 2/12 on the tasks
the baseline failed at least once
tasks were authored to invite classes the store covers,
so this measures a briefing when a lesson exists.
